tickerText: [TENNIS] Elena Rybakina beat Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 to win the US Open and claim world No. 1 — Ben Shelton faces Alexander Zverev in Sunday's men's final at Arthur Ashe • [SQUASH] QTerminals Qatar Classic Platinum moves into round two in Doha as Anahat Singh meets top seed Tinne Gilis and Nouran Gohar continues her PSA comeback • [BADMINTON] Asian Games badminton opens Sept 20 in Ichinomiya as world No. 1 An Se-young chases back-to-back women's singles gold and Malaysia's Nur Izzuddin–Goh Sze Fei target men's doubles glory • [PICKLEBALL] Championship Sunday at the PPA Asia 1000 KL Cup crowns five pro titles at The Hood after Saturday's semifinals set Tardio–Khlif and other final matchups • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao semifinals and evening singles finals at the East Asian Games Dome feature Chen Xingtong, Chen Yi, Harimoto, Moregard and Calderano

newsItems.title: Shelton Chases US Open Glory
newsItems.excerpt: Ben Shelton meets top seed Alexander Zverev in Sunday's men's final at Arthur Ashe after Elena Rybakina dethroned Aryna Sabalenka to lift the women's trophy and the world No. 1 ranking.

newsItems.title: Qatar Classic Hits Round Two
newsItems.excerpt: The QTerminals Qatar Classic Platinum advances to round two in Doha, with India's Anahat Singh set to face world No. 9 Tinne Gilis after beating Farida Mohamed in four games.

newsItems.title: Shuttle Stars Eye Asian Games
newsItems.excerpt: Badminton at Aichi-Nagoya begins September 20 as An Se-young rides a China Masters title into a bid for consecutive Asian Games women's singles gold and India's team events kick off.

newsItems.title: KL Cup Finals Day in Kuala Lumpur
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Asia 1000 Leapmotor Kuala Lumpur Cup concludes Sunday at The Hood with pro medal matches across singles, doubles and mixed after Saturday's semifinals locked in the championship lineups.
